name: context-mode
description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
one_liner: A plug-in for AI coding assistants that keeps giant tool outputs, like a 300KB webpage snapshot, out of the conversation, so the AI doesn't 'forget' earlier work or run out of room to think.
buyer: An engineering lead running Claude Code or similar AI agents on large codebases who is burning through tokens and losing session continuity.
business_use_cases: A dev team installs it so their AI pair-programmer stops forgetting which files it was editing after a long session, cutting re-explaining time.
A consultancy billing clients by AI-agent usage reduces token costs roughly 98% on big tool outputs, improving margins on fixed-fee AI-dev contracts.
An enterprise rolls it out across engineering to enforce 'think in code' patterns, reducing runaway API costs from verbose agent chatter.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted or managed enterprise tier with team dashboards and usage analytics.

steal_this: It's a developer productivity tool, not a consumer product; adopt it internally to cut your own AI tooling costs, then tell other dev teams how much you saved.
